Retirement requires prior cleanup of the one collected, wrongProduction BroadwayWorld file; the executor refuses while it remains.
steps: Prerequisite outside this worker scope: resolve the collected age-is-a-feeling-off-broadway-2024/broadwayworld--team-bww.json file in the private review-texts repository. There are zero scored reviews, but the executor counts this file and will refuse retirement until it is removed or moved appropriately.
After the collected-file prerequisite is resolved, apply this plan through execute-approved-fix.yml to retire only age-is-a-feeling-off-broadway-2024 and archive its row.

Verify the retired registry contains the 2024 Vineyard id and shows.json no longer contains it. Preserve the separate 2026 Soho Theatre Walthamstow production and allow future rescheduled Vineyard runs under their own ids.

actions.reason: BRO-5263: Vineyard Theatre states that the scheduled September 11 to October 13, 2024 US premiere was postponed before rehearsals began. This run never played; its previewsStartDate is a cancelled schedule, not evidence of performance. Retire this id only so a future rescheduled run remains discoverable.
